Regression spot-checks on /api/admin/sanity, /api/admin/sanity/untagged, /api/admin/attribution-matrix, /api/admin/waitlist.csv, /api/admin/utm-links.csv, /api/formats, /api/admin/waitlist, /api/admin/experiments, /api/short/{slug} (both real + 404 miss) and /api/analytics/track all green. action_items: (Cosmetic, out-of-scope for iter-13) The review spec mentions a `footnote` data-testid on the matrix panel — the codebase never had one; the footnote div at AdminPanel.jsx line 679-683 currently renders without any data-testid. If future tests want to target it, add data-testid='matrix-footnote' or 'footnote' to that <div>. Not blocking.

(Carry-over from iter-12) Outline buttons on WaitlistForm.jsx lines 109/114 still inherit text-white when embedded in Landing.jsx's <section class='bg-ink-900 text-white'>. Add `text-ink-900` to those classNames. Unrelated to iter-13.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py admin_attribution_matrix_csv (lines 703-735) — Clean delegation to admin_attribution_matrix(_admin=_admin) guarantees JSON↔CSV numeric consistency (verified via round-trip pytest). csv.writer + io.StringIO is stdlib-only, no new deps. Response uses media_type='text/csv' + Content-Disposition attachment with `date.today().isoformat()` filename. Emits exactly 1 header + rows×cols + rows (row-totals) + cols (col-totals) + 1 grand = 21 lines on current data; matches spec's formula. Nit: `date.today()` uses server local time — if the container is not UTC, filename date could differ from what admin expects; consider `datetime.now(timezone.utc).date().isoformat()` for consistency with the rest of the code base which already uses timezone.utc everywhere. Not a functional bug (test allowed today or previous day).

server.py — Reusing admin_attribution_matrix() by directly calling `data = await admin_attribution_matrix(_admin=_admin)` is a great pattern: single source of truth for the math. If we ever add caching to the matrix, both endpoints benefit automatically.

AdminPanel.jsx (lines 591-615) — Header changed from block to `flex items-start justify-between gap-3 flex-wrap`. `flex-wrap` + `shrink-0` on the button keeps it visible at 390px (confirmed via bounding-box measurement). Button uses variant='outline' with `text-ink-900` class explicitly — smart, avoids the iter-12 cascade bug. Anchor synthesis is safe: creates <a>, sets href, sets download='', clicks, removes. `a.download=""` uses the server-supplied Content-Disposition filename — correct.

AdminPanel.jsx — `new URL(...)` wrapper on line 606 is defensive; the returned .toString() normalizes the URL. If REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL were ever missing it would throw synchronously (visible in the toast onClick handler with no try/catch — a very minor edge case; probably won't hit in practice since app-wide many other calls already assume it).

Round-trip integrity — Pytest verified every one of the 12 cell rows, 3 row-total lines, 4 col-total lines, and 1 grand total exactly match the JSON endpoint. This is the strongest possible test for numeric consistency.
